post.description: Schedule a draft or scheduled broadcast to send to its audience at a future time. The answer carries `recipients`, the recipients it would take at that moment (ADR 0149). An email broadcast is a 409 postal_address_required while the Workspace has no postal address (`postalAddress` of `GET /workspace`, set only in the console, ADR 0156). Send-class: needs the broadcasts:send scope, and mcp:send over MCP.

post.description:
Record consent a phone number gave outside sphericon (a form of your own, a verification
service), as an `imported` confirmation with its evidence: the wording shown, where it was
collected and the brand. The evidence is kept in the immutable `sms.confirmed` event.
A number already confirmed keeps its confirmation unless the new one is stronger, so the
answer is the confirmation that stands. It does not lift an opt-out: only the person can, by
texting START. Consent recorded before the number last withdrew it changes nothing and is
refused with a conflict.

skipped as `no_enrollment_key`; a contact has at most 10 active enrollments and 10 begun in a
day, past which an entry is skipped as `enrollment_ceiling`. An exit or goal Event carrying the
property ends only the enrollment of its value. Absent, a contact has one active enrollment.

A Trigger that enrolls a Contact on an Event (ADR 0133): its action, and an optional filter on
that Event's own properties, so `order.completed` where `status` is `paid` starts on paid orders
only. An Event that fails the filter is no entry: it enrolls no one and is not a skipped entry.

SkippedEntryReason.description:
Why an entry into an automation was skipped, by the first entry check that refused it (ADR 0127,
ADR 0165), in their order: `no_enrollment_key` (the automation has an Enrollment key and the
triggering Event lacks its property), `cycle` (the chain of events that caused it already passed
through the automation), `active_enrollment` (the triggering Event occurred while an enrollment
of the contact for the key value was active, or one is active still), `once` (the contact had an
enrollment for the key value in the automation before, under the `once` entry policy),
`cooldown` (under `again`, the cooldown from the beginning of the contact's previous enrollment
for the key value had not passed) or `enrollment_ceiling` (the keyed automation's contact had 10
active enrollments, or 10 begun in a day). An occurrence of a date Trigger (ADR 0126) is skipped as
`active_enrollment` (an enrollment of the contact was active at its moment), `missed` (it was
reached 24 hours late or more while its date was already set at its moment) or `send_locked` (its
date was set through a Connection without mcp:send; a later write of another value without the mark may
still enroll it within 24 hours).
